name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc31): the green Excel button on a table toolbar now works - loading rows into a table from a .csv or .xlsx file on an older-style screen. Acumatica had been accepting the file and then quietly writing nothing, with no error anywhere, because the request was missing one piece of information a browser fills in and a script does not. Also: a save refused because your session was taken over in another tab is now retried once instead of being lost. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
